What this is

0entities
0sources
0exact positions

A database of games-technology activity across the island of Ireland: studios, publishers, education, services, events and adjacent sectors. Built for a QUB research project (DSA8030) at Medialab. Every entry comes from a public source and links back to it.

Location accuracy

0✔ verified
0exact · pending
0≈ approximate

Every record shows how precise its position is. ✔ Verified location means the address was checked against the entity's own site or the company register, then geocoded independently. Only these records link to Google Maps. ≈ Approximate area means we know the town or county, not the address, so the marker sits somewhere in that area.

About the data

Built from public sources: company registries, industry directories, funding awards and community sites. Each entry links back to where it was found. Duplicates are merged, and nothing appears here that a source did not state.

Questions about the data or a listing? Contact MediaLab, Queen's University Belfast, 28 University Square, Belfast BT7 1PA.

Self-reported personal details appear only with consent. County boundaries: GADM (academic use).
